description: This Java class 'ReadableShippingSummary' represents a data structure for shipping summary details in a shopping or e-commerce application. It contains fields related to shipping costs, options, and textual descriptions, along with getters and setters. It implements Serializable for object serialization.

classes.name: ReadableShippingSummary
classes.description: A Java class encapsulating shipping summary details, including costs, options, and related attributes, used within the web layer of the application.

methods.name: getShipping
methods.description: Returns the shipping cost as a BigDecimal.

methods.name: getHandling
methods.description: Returns the handling cost as a BigDecimal.

methods.name: getShippingOption
methods.description: Returns the shipping option as a string.

methods.name: isTaxOnShipping
methods.description: Returns whether tax applies on shipping.

methods.name: setTaxOnShipping
methods.description: Sets whether tax applies on shipping.

methods.name: getSerialversionuid
methods.description: Returns the serialVersionUID for serialization compatibility.

methods.name: getShippingOptions
methods.description: Returns a list of available shipping options.

methods.name: setShippingOptions
methods.description: Sets the list of available shipping options.

methods.name: getSelectedShippingOption
methods.description: Returns the currently selected shipping option.
